Please note: The new Titan TXP range is not compatible with previous non-TXP Titan tools and batteries.

Titan TTI801BAT 18V Li-Ion TXP battery provides reliable power for cordless tools. Suitable for a range of indoor and outdoor applications, supporting tasks from carpentry to plumbing. Features battery capacity and low battery indicators, allowing for efficient power management during demanding jobs. The power tool battery is compatible with all Titan TXP 18V tools.
